en: Black‑and‑white view of a quiet cobblestone lane inside what appears to be an old European town. On the left is a massive stone tower or wall with a mounted gas streetlamp; on the right are rough‑plastered medieval-looking houses with small windows and barred openings. In the background, a larger historic building with steep gabled roof, dormer windows, and arched doorway faces a small open green with trees. The overall scene feels like a walled old town or castle precinct captured in an early 20th‑century photograph.
